# Kaggle & Colab Terminal Relay

> Connect, execute remote bash commands, and transfer files on Kaggle or Google Colab GPU notebooks over an SSH-through-Cloudflare relay.

This service allows autonomous AI agents and developers to interact with Kaggle/Colab GPU runtimes without manual browser interaction.

## Quick Start for Agents

- **Run command on remote notebook**:
  ```bash
  export RELAY_SECRET="{{ RELAY_SECRET }}"
  curl -fsSL {{ RELAY_URL }}/kssh.sh | bash -s run "nvidia-smi"
  ```
- **Upload file to notebook**:
  ```bash
  curl -fsSL {{ RELAY_URL }}/kssh.sh | bash -s put <local_file> <remote_path>
  ```
- **Download file from notebook**:
  ```bash
  curl -fsSL {{ RELAY_URL }}/kssh.sh | bash -s get <remote_path> <local_file>
  ```

## Core APIs & Documentation

- [Full LLM Context]({{ RELAY_URL }}/info.md): Complete setup guide, commands, and session details in Markdown format.
- [Active Kernels]({{ RELAY_URL }}/kernels): JSON list of active sessions with GPU/CPU/RAM specifications and real-time status.
- [Setup Script]({{ RELAY_URL }}/setup.sh): Unified setup script for Kaggle and Google Colab environments.
- [Client Script]({{ RELAY_URL }}/client.sh): Client script for interactive SSH shells and listing sessions.
- [Key Upload Script]({{ RELAY_URL }}/upload_key.sh): Helper script to upload client SSH public key to the relay.

## Authentication

Pass the secret via the `X-Relay-Secret` HTTP header, or set `export RELAY_SECRET="{{ RELAY_SECRET }}"` in bash commands.

## Preventing Timeouts for Long Agent Workflows

Kaggle interactive sessions time out after 40 minutes of idle browser time.
- **Headless 12h Runs**: Run `setup.sh -b` inside a Kaggle notebook and commit via **Save Version -> Save & Run All**. The VM runs headless on GPU for up to 12 hours with your computer completely off.
- **In-Browser Anti-Idle**: Inject an IPython JavaScript keepalive interval in interactive mode.
